name: model-select
notes: ADR-0106: join the completed zoos' compare artifacts and name one winner by a config-declared metric. Read-only — no refit, no promotion, no lockbox read. Append a source for any zoo once its staged compare.json finishes (all candidates n_scored == n_folds); a source with an empty or incomplete ranking is refused by name.

select.notes: Winner is argmax of each candidate's mean path score across both zoos. P15 is intentionally absent: its staged compare.json still has an empty ranking while candidates finish. Append a p15 source here once it completes.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity - where metrics land is not what it computes.
